sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) The public debt shall be a charge upon the Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic. (2) For the purposes of this Article, the public debt includes the principal debt, interest payable in respect of that debt, sinking fund payments for the gradual repayment of that debt, and all costs incidental to the management of that debt.
